# Custom resource field reference

For: chart authors who write harbor-operator resources.

<!-- Generated by `make generate` from config/crd/bases. Do not edit. -->

Every field of the `harbor.soliddowant.dev/v1alpha1` resources. A field marked `yes` in the Required column must be set. The page [write a project and a robot](example.md) shows them in use.

## HarborConnection

Short name: `hconn`. Category: `harbor`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `spec.allowAdoption` | boolean |  | AllowAdoption lets resources that use this connection adopt existing Harbor objects. |
| `spec.allowContentDeletion` | boolean |  | AllowContentDeletion lets projects that use this connection with deletionPolicy DeleteWithContents delete every repository in the project, and so every image, before the project is deleted. |
| `spec.allowedNamespaces` | object |  | AllowedNamespaces admits HarborProject resources. |
| `spec.allowedNamespaces.names` | list of string |  | Names is an explicit list of namespace names. |
| `spec.allowedNamespaces.selector` | object |  | Selector admits every namespace whose labels match. |
| `spec.caBundle` | string |  | CABundle is a PEM bundle that signs Harbor's certificate. |
| `spec.credentialsSecretRef` | object | yes | CredentialsSecretRef names a Secret in this namespace and the keys in it that hold the username and the password. Without key settings the keys are username and password. |
| `spec.credentialsSecretRef.name` | string | yes | Name of the Secret. |
| `spec.credentialsSecretRef.passwordKey` | string |  | PasswordKey is the key in the Secret that holds the password. Defaults to password. |
| `spec.credentialsSecretRef.username` | string |  | Username is the literal user name. Use it when the Secret has no user name key. Excludes usernameKey. |
| `spec.credentialsSecretRef.usernameKey` | string |  | UsernameKey is the key in the Secret that holds the user name. Defaults to username. |
| `spec.defaults` | object |  | Defaults for resources that use this connection. |
| `spec.defaults.deletionPolicy` | string |  | DeletionPolicy applies to resources with an empty deletionPolicy. One of `Delete`, `DeleteWithContents`, `Orphan`. |
| `spec.defaults.resyncInterval` | string |  | ResyncInterval is how often resources are compared with Harbor again. |
| `spec.insecureSkipVerify` | boolean |  | InsecureSkipVerify turns off certificate checks. |
| `spec.registryHost` | string |  | RegistryHost is host[:port] written into docker configs. Defaults to the host of Harbor's external_url. |
| `spec.systemAllowedNamespaces` | object |  | SystemAllowedNamespaces admits Harbor-wide kinds. |
| `spec.systemAllowedNamespaces.names` | list of string |  | Names is an explicit list of namespace names. |
| `spec.systemAllowedNamespaces.selector` | object |  | Selector admits every namespace whose labels match. |
| `spec.url` | string | yes | URL of Harbor, for example https://harbor.example.com. No path. |
| `status.conditions` | list of object |  |  |
| `status.conditions[].lastTransitionTime` | time | yes | lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another. This should be when the underlying condition changed. If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable. |
| `status.conditions[].message` | string | yes | message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition. This may be an empty string. |
| `status.conditions[].observedGeneration` | integer |  | observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon. For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date with respect to the current state of the instance. |
| `status.conditions[].reason` | string | yes | reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition. Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field, and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API. The value should be a CamelCase string. This field may not be empty. |
| `status.conditions[].status` | string | yes | status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown. One of `True`, `False`, `Unknown`. |
| `status.conditions[].type` | string | yes | type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase. |
| `status.harborIdentity` | string |  | HarborIdentity is Harbor's normalized external_url. |
| `status.harborVersion` | string |  | HarborVersion as reported by Harbor. |
| `status.observedGeneration` | integer |  | ObservedGeneration is the last generation reconciled. |
| `status.registryHost` | string |  | RegistryHost used in docker configs. |

## HarborImmutabilityPolicy

Short name: `himm`. Category: `harbor`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |

| `spec.deletionPolicy` | string |  | DeletionPolicy empty means the connection's default. One of `Delete`, `DeleteWithContents`, `Orphan`. |

| `spec.projectRef.name` | string | yes | Name of the object. |
| `spec.projectRef.namespace` | string |  | Namespace of the object. Empty means the namespace of the referring resource. |
| `spec.resyncInterval` | string |  | ResyncInterval empty means the connection's default. |
| `spec.rules` | list of object | yes |  |
| `spec.rules[].disabled` | boolean |  |  |
| `spec.rules[].repositories` | object | yes | RepositorySelector picks repositories by a doublestar pattern. |
| `spec.rules[].repositories.decoration` | string | yes | Decoration says whether the pattern includes or excludes. One of `repoMatches`, `repoExcludes`. |
| `spec.rules[].repositories.pattern` | string | yes | Pattern is a doublestar pattern, for example `**`. |
| `spec.rules[].tags` | object | yes | ImmutabilityTagSelector picks tags by a doublestar pattern. It is used by immutability rules, which have no untagged option. |
| `spec.rules[].tags.decoration` | string | yes | Decoration says whether the pattern includes or excludes. One of `matches`, `excludes`. |
| `spec.rules[].tags.pattern` | string | yes | Pattern is a doublestar pattern, for example `**`. |
| `status.conditions` | list of object |  |  |
| `status.conditions[].lastTransitionTime` | time | yes | lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another. This should be when the underlying condition changed. If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable. |
| `status.conditions[].message` | string | yes | message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition. This may be an empty string. |
| `status.conditions[].observedGeneration` | integer |  | observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon. For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date with respect to the current state of the instance. |
| `status.conditions[].reason` | string | yes | reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition. Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field, and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API. The value should be a CamelCase string. This field may not be empty. |
| `status.conditions[].status` | string | yes | status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown. One of `True`, `False`, `Unknown`. |
| `status.conditions[].type` | string | yes | type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase. |
| `status.harborKey` | string |  | HarborKey is the Harbor identity, object type and project name this resource claims. |
| `status.observedGeneration` | integer |  | ObservedGeneration is the last generation reconciled. |
| `status.projectID` | integer |  | ProjectID in Harbor. Set only while this resource owns the project's immutability rules. |

| `status.observedRotate` | string |  | ObservedRotate is the last spec.secret.rotate value acted on. |
| `status.robotID` | integer |  | RobotID in Harbor. |

## HarborProject

Short name: `hproj`. Category: `harbor`.

| `spec.deletionPolicy` | string |  | DeletionPolicy empty means the connection's default. One of `Delete`, `DeleteWithContents`, `Orphan`. |
| `spec.name` | string |  | Name of the Harbor project. Defaults to metadata.name. Immutable. |
| `spec.proxyCache` | object |  | ProxyCache makes the project a proxy cache. Set it at creation or never. |

| `spec.resyncInterval` | string |  | ResyncInterval empty means the connection's default. |
| `spec.storageQuota` | quantity |  | StorageQuota must be greater than zero. Use unlimitedStorage for no limit. |
| `spec.unlimitedStorage` | boolean |  | UnlimitedStorage writes -1 as the quota. |
| `spec.vulnerability` | object |  | VulnerabilitySpec holds the project's vulnerability settings. Unset fields are not touched. |
| `spec.vulnerability.cveAllowlist` | object |  | CVEAllowlist is a project's list of CVEs that do not block pulls. |
| `spec.vulnerability.cveAllowlist.expiresAt` | time |  | ExpiresAt is when the allowlist stops applying. Unset means never. |
| `spec.vulnerability.cveAllowlist.items` | list of string |  | Items are CVE IDs. The list replaces Harbor's whole list. |
| `spec.vulnerability.preventVulnerableImages` | boolean |  |  |
| `spec.vulnerability.scanOnPush` | boolean |  |  |
| `spec.vulnerability.severity` | string |  | Severity is the level at and above which images are blocked. One of `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `critical`. |
| `spec.vulnerability.useSystemAllowlist` | boolean |  |  |
| `status.conditions` | list of object |  |  |
| `status.conditions[].lastTransitionTime` | time | yes | lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another. This should be when the underlying condition changed. If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable. |
| `status.conditions[].message` | string | yes | message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition. This may be an empty string. |
| `status.conditions[].observedGeneration` | integer |  | observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon. For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date with respect to the current state of the instance. |
| `status.conditions[].reason` | string | yes | reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition. Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field, and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API. The value should be a CamelCase string. This field may not be empty. |
| `status.conditions[].status` | string | yes | status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown. One of `True`, `False`, `Unknown`. |
| `status.conditions[].type` | string | yes | type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase. |
| `status.createPending` | time |  | CreatePending is set just before the operator asks Harbor to create the project, and cleared once the ID is recorded or Harbor refuses the create. A project found in Harbor counts as this resource's own interrupted create only when it was created no earlier than this time, less a clock-skew allowance. |
| `status.harborKey` | string |  | HarborKey is the Harbor identity, object type and Harbor name this resource claims. |
| `status.harborName` | string |  | HarborName is the project's name in Harbor. |
| `status.observedGeneration` | integer |  | ObservedGeneration is the last generation reconciled. |
| `status.projectID` | integer |  | ProjectID in Harbor. |

A robot found in Harbor counts as this resource's own interrupted create only when it was created no earlier than this time, less a clock-skew allowance. |
| `status.expiresAt` | time |  | ExpiresAt is when the robot expires. Unset means never. |
| `status.harborKey` | string |  | HarborKey is the Harbor identity, project name and robot name this resource claims. |
| `status.harborName` | string |  | HarborName is the robot's name as Harbor returned it, including Harbor's prefix. |
| `status.lastRotated` | time |  | LastRotated is when the secret was last refreshed. |
| `status.observedGeneration` | integer |  | ObservedGeneration is the last generation reconciled. |
| `status.observedRotate` | string |  | ObservedRotate is the last spec.secret.rotate value acted on. |
| `status.robotID` | integer |  | RobotID in Harbor. |
